description: Read organizational data source configurations, data quality reports, and metadata in Microsoft 365 without configuring data ingestion, connections, or settings.
richDescription:
Assign the Organizational Data Source Reader role to users who need to do the following tasks:
* Read organizational data source configurations and connection metadata for ingested HR data
* Read organizational data quality reports for the ingested HR data
* Monitor and infer data quality metrics such as completeness and coverage for ingested attributes
* Identify data quality issues and motivate improvements
* Download user data quality reports
